reference: Quantization quality: original BF16 of the same model; layer streaming/offload is allowed. If impractical on this Orin, use same-model FP8 and explicitly label the fallback. Community AWQ same-weight comparison is only an implementation diagnostic.
fast_suite: 12 short text scenarios, at most 48 generated tokens each. Freeze baseline token histories and top-3 probabilities once. Candidate runs reuse them.
extended_suite: 512/2K/8K contextual retrieval with seeded irrelevant records; select a small fixed answer-token window for scores.
Actual multi-turn extension, prefix reuse and branch-state checks.
pairing: Both engines condition on exactly the same rendered/tokenized prompt and baseline teacher-forced output prefix at each scored position. Do not align different freely generated histories by index.
probability_queries: Request candidate full-vocabulary-normalized log probabilities on baseline top-3 IDs. If absent from candidate top-k response, explicitly query the missing IDs via a scoring adapter or forced-token branch; never replace missing probability with zero.
two_execution_paths: Batched teacher-forced prefill scoring for rapid format/kernel screening.
Sequential teacher-forced decode scoring for GDN/KV state updates and prefix restoration. Prefill-only scoring cannot validate decode.
free_generation: Separately generate candidate output with the fixed seed and evaluate task checks. Divergence is reported, not treated as automatic task failure.
timing: Cache baseline scores once; measure candidate evaluation separately from model startup.
determinism: Record global and request seeds, model/tokenizer/template hashes, engine/kernel versions, numerical dtypes, KV format, batch membership/order and sampling configuration. Repeat baseline to quantify numerical nondeterminism.
quality_gates: Do not require identical token choices or impose token-agreement/max-probability-error pass thresholds. Evaluate task correctness/answer quality, reference-answer target NLL/perplexity and long-context tasks versus BF16 (FP8 fallback). Token flips, confidence buckets and top3 probability changes are diagnostic signals, including high-confidence flips; a different valid answer is not a failure. Admit W4-resident/temporary-W8/A8 INT8 paths based on measured quality and full-chain speed.
context_hash: SHA256 over canonical actual token IDs and positions, plus normalized multimodal tensor/position identity for image scores.

top3_item.token_id: integer token ID, never decoded string identity
top3_item.logprob: finite natural-log probability normalized over the entire vocabulary

candidate_selected_token_id: Optional; greedy fast suite requires top1 with stable token-ID tie breaking.
multimodal_suite: Single images and ordered multi-images; fixed-seed poster, landscape, anime and color/order task checks, official BF16 visual encoder and text reference. Raw token identity is diagnostic; normalize case/leading spaces only for label task checks.
acceptance_scope: Bounded quick evaluation accepted; no claim of comprehensive benchmark, OCR or video quality.
